title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 2（2026-10-30）
summary: 今天加入 Part 3 對話題，並補上代名詞、關係子句、不定詞與動名詞。點選答案立即看對錯與解析，做完把分數回報到聊天室。

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: 作答技巧：先看選項。如果四個選項是同一個字的不同詞性，就只看空格前後決定詞性，不用讀完整句。

qs.stem: The ------- of the new software took three days.
qs.exp: 冠詞 The 後面、介系詞 of 前面要放名詞：installation（安裝）。install 是動詞；installed 是過去式 / 過去分詞；installing 雖可當動名詞，但有現成名詞時 TOEIC 會選名詞。

qs.stem: Mr. Park will present ------- findings at the board meeting.
qs.exp: 名詞 findings 前面要用所有格 his（他的研究結果）。he 是主格；him 是受格；himself 是反身代名詞，用在主詞與受詞同一人時。

qs.stem: The technician ------- repaired the printer has already left the office.
qs.exp: 先行詞 technician 是人，關係代名詞在子句中當主詞（___ repaired the printer），用 who。which 指物；whose 後面要接名詞；whom 是受格，不能當主詞。

qs.stem: We look forward to ------- with your team on the next project.
qs.exp: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。這是 TOEIC 超高頻陷阱，同類還有 be used to V-ing、be committed to V-ing。

qs.stem: The company has decided ------- a new branch in Kaohsiung.
qs.exp: decide 後面接 to + 原形動詞（decide to do）。同類動詞：plan、hope、agree、refuse。enjoy、avoid、consider、finish 則接 V-ing。

qs.stem: The quarterly report is due ------- Monday morning.
qs.exp: 特定某一天（含某天的早上）用 on：on Monday morning。in 用在月份、年份或沒有指定哪天的 in the morning；at 用在時刻（at 9 A.M.）。

qs.stem: Please keep your receipt as ------- of purchase.
qs.exp: 固定搭配 proof of purchase（購買證明）。account 是帳戶；sign 是標誌；view 是看法，都不合語意。

qs.stem: ------- the weather was poor, the company picnic was held as planned.
qs.exp: 前後語意相反（天氣差，但照常舉行），且空格後是完整子句，要用連接詞 Although。Despite 是介系詞，只接名詞；Because 語意不合；However 是副詞，不能連接兩個子句。

qs.stem: This is the ------- efficient engine our team has ever designed.
qs.exp: the + 最高級 + 名詞 + have ever p.p. 是最高級的典型句型，用 the most efficient。more 是比較級，要搭配 than；much、very 不能構成這個句型。

qs.stem: The survey results ------- to all participants last week.
qs.exp: 兩個線索：last week 是過去時間；結果是「被寄出」，所以用過去式被動 were sent。sent 是主動；will send 是未來；are sending 是現在進行主動。

qs.stem: All visitors are required to ------- at the front desk upon arrival.
qs.exp: register at the front desk（在櫃台登記）。attend 是出席（attend a meeting），apply 是申請（apply for），attach 是附加（attach a file），放在這裡都不通順。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 建議先看題目再讀信件，帶著問題找答案。
passage: From: Sarah Ho, Customer Service, Delta Tools

Thank you for your order of twelve cordless drills. Unfortunately, the model you requested is currently out of stock because of high demand. We expect new stock to arrive on November 12, and your order will be shipped the following day.

If you would prefer not to wait, we can offer a similar model, the DT-500, at the same price. Please reply to this e-mail by November 6 to let us know your choice. As an apology for the delay, we will waive the shipping fee for this order.

qs.stem: Why did Ms. Ho write to Mr. Liu?
opts: To explain a delay in an order
qs.exp: 主旨題：第一段說他訂的型號缺貨（out of stock），會晚出貨，所以是說明訂單延誤。DT-500 只是替代方案，不是廣告。

qs.stem: If Mr. Liu chooses to wait, when will his order be shipped?
qs.exp: 推算題：新貨 11/12 到，the following day（隔天）出貨，也就是 11/13。11/6 是回覆期限，11/12 是到貨日，都是數字陷阱。

qs.stem: What is Mr. Liu asked to do?
qs.exp: 換句話說題：Please reply to this e-mail by November 6 = respond by a certain date。文中沒有要他打電話或上網站；運費反而免除。

qs.stem: In paragraph 2, the word “waive” is closest in meaning to
qs.exp: 同義字題：waive the fee 是「免除費用」= not charge。上下文是 As an apology（為了致歉），一定是對客人有利的事，可以用語境排除 increase 和 delay。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 按播放鍵聽題目和 A、B、C 三個回應，再點選答案。正式考試看不到文字，建議先不要打開文字稿。

qs.stem: Where should I put these boxes?
qs.exp: Where 問地點 → Next to the copier。A 重複 boxes、回答數量；C 用 Yes 回答 Wh 問句，而且 put on 是「穿上」。

qs.stem: Do you want to have lunch now or later?
qs.exp: A or B 選擇疑問句，不能用 Yes / No 回答，要選其中一個 → Later。B 是典型陷阱；C 時態是過去，而且答非所問。

qs.stem: How long does the training session take?
qs.exp: How long 問時間長度 → About two hours。A 回答 When；B 重複 long，但講的是距離。

qs.stem: Why don't we order more printer paper?
qs.exp: Why don't we...? 不是問原因，而是「提議」一起做某事，所以回答同意或拒絕。A 用 Because 是陷阱；C 重複 paper。

qs.stem: You've met our new engineer, haven't you?
qs.exp: 附加問句「你見過新工程師了，對吧？」→ Yes，在昨天的會議上。A 用 meet 的相近音；C 重複 engineer，沒回答有沒有見過。

sections.heading: Part 3 簡短對話（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 正式考試中 Part 3 的題目與選項會印在題本上，所以這裡直接顯示選項。先讀兩題題目，再按播放聽對話。
script: W: Hi, Tom. Are the safety inspection reports ready? The factory manager wants them by Thursday.
M: Almost. I'm still waiting for the data from the second production line. A sensor there broke down yesterday.
W: I see. Why don't you call the maintenance department and ask when it'll be fixed?
M: Good idea. I'll do that right now.

qs.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
qs.exp: 主旨題通常在開頭：女生問報告準備好了沒、經理要週四前交，所以是報告期限。factory 有出現，但 new factory 是重複字陷阱。

qs.stem: What will the man probably do next?
qs.exp: 下一步題答案通常在最後：女生建議 call the maintenance department，男生說 I'll do that right now。call = contact，是換句話說。
